card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

mechanism: A rushes acceptance of a delivered sofa before anyone evaluates whether it fits.
confusable: Unlike merely liking a bargain, A must delay the practical check until after commitment.
comparison: D28-b uses the arrival to accelerate assent; D28-a uses a booking deadline to defer capacity and price review.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
